text: Add-item flow: 'add another' mode for consecutive adds (Android; optionally web)

Done in f70dc06 (Android; web left for later per the ticket's "optionally"). Add
dialog gained an "Add another" action beside "Add": ItemFormViewModel.saveAndAddAnother
saves then resets to a blank add form and bumps a focusNameSignal; AddItemDialog
watches that signal and re-requests focus on the Name field (FocusRequester). "Add"
keeps close-on-save; edit mode untouched. Test: saveAndAddAnother creates the item,
leaves isSaved=false, clears name, bumps the signal.

Not done (ticket's optional extras): backlog/most-recently-checked suggestions when
Name is empty, and the web parity — both deferred.
